scientific_limitations: Only length-n binary words with exactly three ones; linear contiguous factors, not cyclic or scattered words.
The limit is conditional on fixed Hamming weight three; it does not describe i.i.d. fair binary words.
The exact density of the Dirichlet functional is not claimed; the result provides a piecewise law and two moments.
Unindexed equivalent mathematical work remains a historical-priority risk.
title: Exact longest-unbordered-factor spectrum of binary three-marker words and its Dirichlet limit law
